# langsmith_examples (Data Source)

Lists the examples in a LangSmith dataset, optionally filtered by split, metadata, or full-text search.

`dataset_id` is required: the LangSmith API rejects an unfiltered example listing with an HTTP 400.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every example in a dataset.
data "langsmith_examples" "all" {
  dataset_id = langsmith_dataset.example.id
}

# Only the examples in the "test" split, as of the "latest" dataset version.
data "langsmith_examples" "test_split" {
  dataset_id = langsmith_dataset.example.id
  splits     = ["test"]
  as_of      = "latest"
}

# Filter by metadata and cap the number of results returned.
data "langsmith_examples" "from_prod" {
  dataset_id = langsmith_dataset.example.id
  metadata   = jsonencode({ source = "prod" })
  limit      = 25
  offset     = 0
}

output "example_count" {
  value = length(data.langsmith_examples.all.examples)
}

output "first_example_inputs" {
  value = try(data.langsmith_examples.all.examples[0].inputs, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_id` (String) The UUID of the dataset whose examples should be listed. Required — the API returns an error if no dataset is supplied.

### Optional

- `as_of` (String) Read the dataset as of a specific version: either a dataset version tag (for example `latest`) or an RFC 3339 timestamp. Only modifications made on or before this point are included. Defaults to the latest version.
- `filter` (String) A LangSmith filter-query string applied server-side to the examples (for example `has(metadata, '{"source": "prod"}')`).
- `full_text_contains` (List of String) Return only examples whose inputs or outputs contain all of these substrings.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of examples to return (1-100). When omitted, the data source pages through the API and returns every matching example.
- `metadata` (String) JSON string of metadata key/value pairs to filter examples by (for example `jsonencode({ source = "prod" })`). Only examples whose metadata contains every supplied pair are returned.
- `offset` (Number) Number of examples to skip before returning results. Defaults to `0`.
- `splits` (List of String) Return only examples belonging to one of these dataset splits (for example `base`, `train`, `test`).
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID to list examples from. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `examples` (Attributes List) The matching examples. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--examples))

<a id="nestedatt--examples"></a>
### Nested Schema for `examples`

Read-Only:

- `attachment_urls` (String) JSON string of the example's attachment URLs, keyed by attachment name.
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the example.
- `dataset_id` (String) The UUID of the dataset this example belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the example.
- `inputs` (String) JSON string containing the input data for the example.
- `metadata` (String) JSON string containing the example metadata. The API stores the example's split under the `dataset_split` key here.
- `modified_at` (String) The last modification timestamp of the example.
- `name` (String) The display name the API derives for the example.
- `outputs` (String) JSON string containing the output data for the example.
- `source_run_id` (String) The UUID of the run this example was created from, if any.
- `source_run_start_time` (String) The start time of the source run, if any.
- `source_session_id` (String) The UUID of the project (session) the source run belongs to, if any.
- `source_trace_id` (String) The UUID of the trace the source run belongs to, if any.
